questions.question: Explain the difference between quality control and quality assurance.

points.text: Quality control checks products AFTER production to find and remove defective items - it's a checkpoint at the end. Quality assurance builds quality INTO the process at every stage, checking throughout so defects are prevented, not just detected. QC = catching problems; QA = preventing problems.

questions.question: Describe two ways TQM can benefit a business.

points.text: TQM benefits: (1) Every employee takes responsibility for quality, reducing defects at source and creating a culture of continuous improvement - this leads to fewer customer complaints and returns. (2) Empowered workers can stop production if they spot a defect, preventing waste of materials and time on faulty batches - reducing costs and improving efficiency.

questions.question: Evaluate whether a small business should invest in ISO 9001 certification.

points.text: Arguments for ISO 9001: signals quality to customers and partners, required by some B2B clients and government contracts, improves internal processes through documentation, builds competitive advantage over non-certified rivals.
